form.label: SysAdmin STIG Operational Compliance View
form.description: Targeted Host Troubleshooting, Historical Trend Analysis, Result Details, and Regression Tracking, powered by NIWC Atlantic's SCAP Compliance Checker (SCC).

search.query: `scap_index` event_type="scan_summary" | eval profile_id=if(isnull(profile_id) OR profile_id=="", "Unknown", profile_id), target_os=if(isnull(target_os) OR target_os=="", "Unknown", target_os), primary_ip=coalesce(primary_ip, ip, "N/A"), benchmark_id=if(isnull(benchmark_id) OR benchmark_id=="", "Unknown", benchmark_id), host_id=coalesce(host_id, smbios_uuid, host, "N/A"), scan_id=coalesce(scan_id, "N/A") | search (target_os="$os_tok$" OR "$os_tok$"="*") (benchmark_id="$bench_tok$" OR "$bench_tok$"="*") host="$host_search_tok$" | stats latest(_time) as max_time, latest(benchmark_score) as latest_score, latest(cat1_fails) as cat1_fail, latest(cat2_fails) as cat2_fail, latest(cat3_fails) as cat3_fail, latest(cat4_fails) as cat4_fail, latest(rules_error) as error_count, latest(rules_not_checked) as not_checked_count, latest(rules_informational) as informational_count, values(primary_ip) as primary_ip, latest(target_os) as target_os, latest(host_id) as host_id, latest(scan_id) as scan_id by host, benchmark_id

`scap_index` (result="*" OR benchmark_score="*" OR score="*") rule_id="*" | eval profile_id=if(isnull(profile_id) OR profile_id=="", "Unknown", profile_id), target_os=if(isnull(target_os) OR target_os=="", "Unknown", target_os), test_type=if(isnull(test_type) OR test_type=="", "Unknown", test_type), primary_ip=coalesce(primary_ip, ip, "N/A"), benchmark_id=if(isnull(benchmark_id) OR benchmark_id=="", "Unknown", benchmark_id), host_id=coalesce(host_id, smbios_uuid, host, "N/A"), scan_id=coalesce(scan_id, "N/A"), clean_res=lower(result), vuln_id=coalesce(nullif(vuln_id,""), "N/A"), cci_id=coalesce(nullif(cci_id,""), "N/A") | search (target_os="$os_tok$" OR "$os_tok$"="*") (benchmark_id="$bench_tok$" OR "$bench_tok$"="*") (test_type="$test_tok$" OR "$test_tok$"="*") host="$host_search_tok$" | stats earliest(clean_res) as first_res, latest(clean_res) as last_res, latest(_time) as max_time, latest(severity) as severity, latest(benchmark_score) as benchmark_score, latest(score) as score, latest(rule_title) as rule_title, latest(title) as title, latest(vuln_id) as vuln_id, latest(cci_id) as cci_id, values(primary_ip) as primary_ip, latest(target_os) as target_os, latest(test_type) as test_type, latest(result_details) as result_details, latest(host_id) as host_id, latest(scan_id) as scan_id by host, benchmark_id, rule_id | eval title=coalesce(nullif(rule_title, ""), nullif(title, ""), rule_id) | eval clean_sev=lower(severity) | eval cat_level=case( clean_sev=="high" OR clean_sev=="cat i" OR clean_sev=="cat_1" OR clean_sev=="1", "CAT I (High)", clean_sev=="medium" OR clean_sev=="cat ii" OR clean_sev=="cat_2" OR clean_sev=="2", "CAT II (Med)", clean_sev=="low" OR clean_sev=="cat iii" OR clean_sev=="cat_3" OR clean_sev=="3", "CAT III (Low)", clean_sev=="informational" OR clean_sev=="cat iv" OR clean_sev=="cat_4" OR clean_sev=="4", "CAT IV (Info)", 1==1, "Other" ) | eval is_fail=if(last_res=="fail", 1, 0) | eval is_pass=if(last_res=="pass", 1, 0) | eval is_error=if(last_res=="error", 1, 0) | eval is_not_checked=if(last_res=="notchecked" OR last_res=="not_checked" OR last_res=="not-checked" OR last_res=="not checked", 1, 0) | eval is_informational=if(last_res=="informational" OR last_res=="info", 1, 0) | eval is_regression=if(first_res=="pass" AND (last_res=="fail" OR last_res=="error"), 1, 0) | eval score_clean=coalesce(tonumber(benchmark_score), tonumber(score), 100)

`scap_index` event_type="scan_summary" | search (benchmark_id="$bench_tok$" OR "$bench_tok$"="*") host="$host_search_tok$" | eval target_os=if(isnull(target_os) OR target_os=="", "Unknown", target_os) | stats count by target_os | sort target_os
`scap_index` event_type="scan_summary" earliest=-30d@d | stats count by benchmark_id | where isnotnull(benchmark_id) AND benchmark_id!="" | sort benchmark_id | fields benchmark_id
`scap_index` earliest=-30d@d | eval test_type=if(isnull(test_type) OR test_type=="", "Unknown", test_type) | stats count by test_type | sort test_type | fields test_type
| stats dc(eval(if(host_id=="N/A", host, host_id))) as count
| stats sum(cat1_fail) as total_cat1_fails by host, host_id | where total_cat1_fails > 0 | stats dc(eval(if(host_id=="N/A", host, host_id))) as count
| stats sum(is_regression) as count

`scap_index` event_type="rule_result" host="$host_search_tok$" | eval clean_res=lower(result), clean_sev=lower(severity), benchmark_id=coalesce(benchmark_id, ruleset, "Unknown") | search (clean_res="fail" OR clean_res="error") (clean_sev="cat1" OR clean_sev="cat i" OR clean_sev="high") (benchmark_id="$bench_tok$" OR "$bench_tok$"="*") | stats dc(rule_id) as unique_cat1_rules | fields unique_cat1_rules
| stats sum(cat1_fail) as count
| stats sum(cat2_fail) as count
| stats sum(cat3_fail) as count
| stats sum(error_count) as count
| stats sum(informational_count) as count
| stats sum(not_checked_count) as count
| stats avg(latest_score) as mean_score | eval mean_score=round(mean_score, 1) | fields mean_score

table.title: Asset Inventory & Compliance Report by Operating System

search.query: `scap_index` event_type="scan_summary" | search (benchmark_id="$bench_tok$" OR "$bench_tok$"="*") host="$host_search_tok$" | eval target_os=if(isnull(target_os) OR target_os=="", "Unknown", target_os), target_os_version=coalesce(target_os_version, os_version, "Unknown"), host_id=coalesce(host_id, smbios_uuid, host, "N/A") | search (target_os="$os_tok$" OR "$os_tok$"="*") | stats dc(eval(if(host_id=="N/A", host, host_id))) as host_count, avg(benchmark_score) as mean_score by target_os, target_os_version | eval mean_score=round(mean_score, 1) | sort - host_count | rename target_os as "OS Name", target_os_version as "OS Version", host_count as "Host Count", mean_score as "Mean Score (%)"

table.title: Enterprise Host Compliance Summary — Ranked by CAT I Failures & Host (Click metric to inspect details)

search.query: `scap_index` event_type="scan_summary" | eval target_os=if(isnull(target_os) OR target_os=="", "Unknown", target_os), target_os_version=coalesce(target_os_version, os_version, "Unknown"), primary_ip=coalesce(primary_ip, ip, "N/A"), scc_version=if(isnull(scc_version) OR scc_version=="", "Unknown", scc_version), benchmark_id=if(isnull(benchmark_id) OR benchmark_id=="", "Unknown", benchmark_id), host_id=coalesce(host_id, smbios_uuid, host, "N/A"), scan_id=coalesce(scan_id, "N/A") | search (target_os="$os_tok$" OR "$os_tok$"="*") (benchmark_id="$bench_tok$" OR "$bench_tok$"="*") host="$host_search_tok$" | stats latest(cat1_fails) as cat1_fail, latest(cat2_fails) as cat2_fail, latest(cat3_fails) as cat3_fail, latest(cat4_fails) as cat4_fail, latest(rules_error) as error_count, latest(rules_informational) as informational_count, latest(rules_not_checked) as not_checked_count, latest(benchmark_score) as latest_score, latest(scc_version) as scc_version, max(_time) as max_time, values(primary_ip) as primary_ip, latest(target_os) as target_os, latest(target_os_version) as target_os_version, latest(host_id) as host_id, latest(scan_id) as scan_id by host, benchmark_id | eval cat1_fail=coalesce(cat1_fail, 0), cat2_fail=coalesce(cat2_fail, 0), cat3_fail=coalesce(cat3_fail, 0), cat4_fail=coalesce(cat4_fail, 0), error_count=coalesce(error_count, 0), informational_count=coalesce(informational_count, 0), not_checked_count=coalesce(not_checked_count, 0) | stats sum(cat1_fail) as "CAT I", sum(cat2_fail) as "CAT II", sum(cat3_fail) as "CAT III", sum(cat4_fail) as "CAT IV", sum(error_count) as "Error", sum(informational_count) as "Info", sum(not_checked_count) as "Not Checked", avg(latest_score) as "Mean Score", latest(scc_version) as scc_version, max(max_time) as latest_scan, values(primary_ip) as primary_ip, latest(target_os) as target_os, latest(target_os_version) as target_os_version, latest(host_id) as host_id, latest(scan_id) as scan_id by host | eval "Mean Score (%)"=round('Mean Score', 1), primary_ip=mvjoin(primary_ip, ", "), host_id=coalesce(host_id, "N/A"), scan_id=coalesce(scan_id, "N/A"), scan_date=strftime(latest_scan, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | fields host, primary_ip, target_os, target_os_version, scc_version, scan_date, "CAT I", "CAT II", "CAT III", "CAT IV", "Error", "Info", "Not Checked", "Mean Score (%)" | sort - "CAT I", + host | head 500 | rename host as "Host", primary_ip as "IP Address", target_os as "Operating System", target_os_version as "OS Version", scc_version as "SCC Version", scan_date as "Latest Scan Date"

table.title: Enterprise STIG Benchmark Compliance Summary — Ranked by CAT I Failures & Benchmark

search.query: | stats sum(cat1_fail) as "CAT I", sum(cat2_fail) as "CAT II", sum(cat3_fail) as "CAT III", sum(cat4_fail) as "CAT IV", sum(error_count) as "Error", sum(informational_count) as "Info", sum(not_checked_count) as "Not Checked", dc(eval(if(host_id=="N/A", host, host_id))) as "Evaluated Hosts", avg(latest_score) as "Mean Score" by benchmark_id | eval "Mean Score (%)"=round(coalesce('Mean Score', 0), 1) | fields benchmark_id, "Evaluated Hosts", "CAT I", "CAT II", "CAT III", "CAT IV", "Error", "Info", "Not Checked", "Mean Score (%)" | sort - "CAT I", + benchmark_id | rename benchmark_id as "STIG Benchmark"

table.title: Enterprise Top Rule Failures Compliance Summary — Ranked by Affected Hosts & Severity

search.query: | search is_fail=1 | stats dc(eval(if(host_id=="N/A", host, host_id))) as "Affected Hosts", latest(vuln_id) as vuln_id, latest(cci_id) as cci_id, latest(title) as title, latest(benchmark_id) as benchmark_id by rule_id, cat_level | sort - "Affected Hosts", cat_level, rule_id | head 25 | table rule_id, vuln_id, cci_id, benchmark_id, cat_level, title, "Affected Hosts" | rename rule_id as "Rule ID", vuln_id as "Vuln ID (V-ID)", cci_id as "CCI", benchmark_id as "STIG Benchmark", cat_level as "Severity", title as "Vulnerability Title"

table.title: Unique CAT I Findings Across Fleet (Sorted by STIG & Rule ID)

search.query: `scap_index` event_type="rule_result" host="$host_search_tok$" | eval clean_res=lower(result), clean_sev=lower(severity), benchmark_id=coalesce(benchmark_id, ruleset, "Unknown"), vuln_id=coalesce(nullif(vuln_id,""),"N/A"), cci_id=coalesce(nullif(cci_id,""),"N/A") | search (clean_res="fail" OR clean_res="error") (clean_sev="cat1" OR clean_sev="cat i" OR clean_sev="high") (benchmark_id="$bench_tok$" OR "$bench_tok$"="*") | stats dc(host) as "Affected Hosts", latest(vuln_id) as vuln_id, latest(cci_id) as cci_id, latest(rule_title) as title by benchmark_id, rule_id | eval title=coalesce(nullif(title, ""), rule_id) | sort benchmark_id, rule_id | table benchmark_id, rule_id, vuln_id, cci_id, title, "Affected Hosts" | rename benchmark_id as "STIG Benchmark", rule_id as "Rule ID", vuln_id as "Vuln ID (V-ID)", cci_id as "CCI", title as "Vulnerability Title"

| stats sum(cat1_fail) as cat1_count, sum(cat2_fail) as cat2_count, sum(cat3_fail) as cat3_count, avg(latest_score) as mean_score, max(max_time) as max_time, latest(target_os) as target_os, values(primary_ip) as primary_ip, latest(host_id) as host_id, latest(scan_id) as scan_id by host | where cat1_count > 0 | eval "Mean Score (%)"=round(mean_score, 1), primary_ip=mvjoin(primary_ip, ", "), host_id=coalesce(host_id, "N/A"), scan_id=coalesce(scan_id, "N/A"), scan_date=strftime(max_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table host, primary_ip, target_os, cat1_count, cat2_count, cat3_count, "Mean Score (%)", scan_date | sort - cat1_count, host | rename host as "Host", primary_ip as "IP Address", target_os as "Operating System", cat1_count as "CAT I Fails", cat2_count as "CAT II Fails", cat3_count as "CAT III Fails", scan_date as "Last Evaluated"

`scap_index` host="$selected_host$" event_type="scan_summary" | eval benchmark_id=if(isnull(benchmark_id) OR benchmark_id=="", "Unknown", benchmark_id), scan_id=coalesce(scan_id, "N/A") | stats max(_time) as max_time, latest(benchmark_score) as benchmark_score, latest(cat1_fails) as "CAT I", latest(cat2_fails) as "CAT II", latest(cat3_fails) as "CAT III", latest(cat4_fails) as "CAT IV", latest(rules_error) as "Error", latest(rules_informational) as "Info", latest(rules_not_checked) as "Not Checked", latest(scan_id) as scan_id by benchmark_id | join type=left benchmark_id [ search `scap_index` host="$selected_host$" (result="*" OR benchmark_score="*" OR score="*") rule_id="*" | stats earliest(lower(result)) as first_res, latest(lower(result)) as last_res by benchmark_id, rule_id | eval is_reg=if(first_res=="pass" AND (last_res=="fail" OR last_res=="error"), 1, 0) | stats sum(is_reg) as "Regressions" by benchmark_id ] | eval "Regressions"=coalesce('Regressions', 0), "Score (%)"=round(benchmark_score, 1), scan_id=coalesce(scan_id, "N/A"), scan_date=strftime(max_time, "%m/%d/%Y %H:%M") | fields benchmark_id, "Score (%)", scan_date, "Regressions", "CAT I", "CAT II", "CAT III", "CAT IV", "Error", "Info", "Not Checked" | sort benchmark_id | rename benchmark_id as "STIG Benchmark", scan_date as "Last Evaluated"

| search is_fail=1 cat_level="$selected_severity$" host="$selected_host$" benchmark_id="$selected_benchmark$" | eval result_details=coalesce(result_details, "No additional detail provided."), scan_id=coalesce(scan_id, "N/A") | eval scan_date=strftime(max_time, "%m/%d/%Y %H:%M") | table host, benchmark_id, rule_id, vuln_id, cci_id, title, result_details, scan_date | sort host, benchmark_id, rule_id | rename host as "Host", benchmark_id as "STIG Benchmark", rule_id as "Rule ID", vuln_id as "Vuln ID (V-ID)", cci_id as "CCI", title as "Vulnerability Title", result_details as "Failure Reason", scan_date as "Evaluated"

| search host="$selected_host$" benchmark_id="$selected_benchmark$" | where ("$selected_status$"=="error" AND is_error==1) OR ("$selected_status$"=="not_checked" AND is_not_checked==1) OR ("$selected_status$"=="informational" AND is_informational==1) OR ("$selected_status$"=="*" AND (is_error==1 OR is_not_checked==1 OR is_informational==1)) | eval result_details=coalesce(result_details, "No additional detail provided."), scan_id=coalesce(scan_id, "N/A") | eval scan_date=strftime(max_time, "%m/%d/%Y %H:%M") | table host, benchmark_id, rule_id, vuln_id, cci_id, title, result_details, scan_date | sort host, benchmark_id, rule_id | rename host as "Host", benchmark_id as "STIG Benchmark", rule_id as "Rule ID", vuln_id as "Vuln ID (V-ID)", cci_id as "CCI", title as "Vulnerability Title", result_details as "Result Detail", scan_date as "Evaluated"

| search is_fail=1 host="$selected_host$" benchmark_id="$selected_benchmark$" | eval raw_col="$clicked_column$" | eval target_cat=case( match(raw_col, "^\\$") OR raw_col=="ALL" OR raw_col=="STIG Benchmark" OR raw_col=="Score (%)" OR raw_col=="Last Evaluated", "ALL", like(raw_col, "%CAT IV%"), "CAT IV (Info)", like(raw_col, "%CAT III%"), "CAT III (Low)", like(raw_col, "%CAT II%"), "CAT II (Med)", like(raw_col, "%CAT I%"), "CAT I (High)", 1==1, "ALL" ) | where target_cat=="ALL" OR cat_level==target_cat | eval result_details=coalesce(result_details, "No additional detail provided."), scan_id=coalesce(scan_id, "N/A") | eval scan_date=strftime(max_time, "%m/%d/%Y %H:%M") | table rule_id, vuln_id, cci_id, cat_level, title, result_details, scan_date | sort cat_level, rule_id | rename rule_id as "Rule ID", vuln_id as "Vuln ID (V-ID)", cci_id as "CCI", cat_level as "Severity", title as "Vulnerability Title", result_details as "Failure Reason", scan_date as "Evaluated"

`scap_index` (result="*" OR benchmark_score="*" OR score="*") rule_id="*" host="$selected_host$" benchmark_id="$selected_benchmark$" | eval clean_res=lower(result), vuln_id=coalesce(nullif(vuln_id,""),"N/A"), cci_id=coalesce(nullif(cci_id,""),"N/A") | sort 0 host, benchmark_id, rule_id, _time | eventstats max(_time) as absolute_latest_time by host, benchmark_id, rule_id | streamstats current=f window=1 last(clean_res) as prev_res, last(_time) as prev_time by host, benchmark_id, rule_id | eval is_reg=if(prev_res=="pass" AND (clean_res=="fail" OR clean_res=="error"), 1, 0) | where is_reg=1 | stats latest(_time) as transition_time, latest(absolute_latest_time) as latest_time, latest(rule_title) as rule_title, latest(title) as title, latest(vuln_id) as vuln_id, latest(cci_id) as cci_id, latest(result_details) as result_details, latest(prev_res) as prev_res, latest(clean_res) as clean_res by host, benchmark_id, rule_id | eval title=coalesce(nullif(rule_title, ""), nullif(title, ""), rule_id) | eval result_details=coalesce(result_details, "No additional detail provided."), regression_date=strftime(transition_time, "%m/%d/%Y %H:%M"), latest_scan_date=strftime(latest_time, "%m/%d/%Y %H:%M"), transition=prev_res . " ➔ " . clean_res | table host, benchmark_id, rule_id, vuln_id, cci_id, title, transition, result_details, regression_date, latest_scan_date | sort - transition_time | rename host as "Host", benchmark_id as "STIG Benchmark", rule_id as "Rule ID", vuln_id as "Vuln ID (V-ID)", cci_id as "CCI", title as "Vulnerability Title", transition as "State Change", result_details as "Failure/Error Detail", regression_date as "Regression Date", latest_scan_date as "Latest Scan Date"

| search is_fail=1 rule_id="$selected_rule_id$" benchmark_id="$selected_benchmark$" | dedup host, benchmark_id, rule_id | join type=left host, benchmark_id [ search `scap_index` event_type="scan_summary" | stats latest(primary_ip) as primary_ip, latest(ip) as ip, latest(target_os) as target_os, latest(host_id) as host_id, latest(scan_id) as scan_id by host, benchmark_id | eval primary_ip=coalesce(primary_ip, ip, "N/A"), target_os=if(isnull(target_os) OR target_os=="", "Unknown", target_os), host_id=coalesce(host_id, "N/A"), scan_id=coalesce(scan_id, "N/A") | fields host, host_id, scan_id, benchmark_id, primary_ip, target_os ] | eval primary_ip=coalesce(primary_ip, "N/A"), target_os=if(isnull(target_os) OR target_os=="", "Unknown", target_os), host_id=coalesce(host_id, "N/A"), scan_id=coalesce(scan_id, "N/A") | eval result_details=coalesce(result_details, "No additional detail provided.") | eval scan_date=strftime(max_time, "%m/%d/%Y %H:%M") | table host, primary_ip, target_os, vuln_id, cci_id, result_details, scan_date | sort host | rename host as "Host", primary_ip as "IP Address", target_os as "Operating System", vuln_id as "Vuln ID (V-ID)", cci_id as "CCI", result_details as "Failure Reason", scan_date as "Evaluated"

panel.title: Overall Mean Compliance Score Over Time: $selected_host$

search.query: `scap_index` host="$selected_host$" event_type="scan_summary" benchmark_score="*" | timechart span=1d avg(benchmark_score) as "Mean Score (%)" | makecontinuous _time span=1d | eval "Mean Score (%)"=round('Mean Score (%)', 1) | fields _time, "Mean Score (%)"

panel.title: Benchmark Compliance Score Trend Over Time: $selected_host$

search.query: `scap_index` host="$selected_host$" event_type="scan_summary" benchmark_score="*" | timechart span=1d avg(benchmark_score) as avg_score by benchmark_id | makecontinuous _time span=1d | eval "Score (%)"=round(avg_score, 1)

panel.title: Enterprise Global Mean Compliance Score Over Time (Scoped Selection)

search.query: `scap_index` event_type="scan_summary" benchmark_score="*" | eval profile_id=if(isnull(profile_id) OR profile_id=="", "Unknown", profile_id), target_os=if(isnull(target_os) OR target_os=="", "Unknown", target_os), benchmark_id=if(isnull(benchmark_id) OR benchmark_id=="", "Unknown", benchmark_id) | search (target_os="$os_tok$" OR "$os_tok$"="*") (benchmark_id="$bench_tok$" OR "$bench_tok$"="*") host="$host_search_tok$" | timechart span=1d avg(benchmark_score) as "Global Mean Score (%)" | makecontinuous _time span=1d | eval "Global Mean Score (%)"=round('Global Mean Score (%)', 1)
